outcome: Bowel morphometry (weight, diameter, thickness of intestinal wall layers)
cohort: Rat fetuses with surgically induced gastroschisis.
finding: Fetal treatment with 0.05 mmol/L S-nitrosoglutathione (GSNO) significantly improved bowel morphology and decreased the expression of NO synthase enzymes in gastroschisis.
birth_weight: Fetal body and intestinal weight were measured.
gest_age: Rat fetuses studied between day 18.5 and 21.5 of gestation.
